historical_note: The historical Narkis Tam Medium alternative used authentic Narkiss Tam Regular outlines with a small black stroke expansion to simulate a Medium/500 appearance, then converted all lettering to vector paths in Inkscape. The tuned values above reproduce the prior output to a negligible render-diff.
